hello.speaker: brunhild
hello.text: Stonefather's peace on you. I am Brunhild Stonehymn. If you have come about the dead, you are the first to come to the right place.

choices.text: The dead are walking. Will you help me put them back?
What do you know about the Barrow?
The binding rites on the old graves have failed, have they not?

lore.speaker: brunhild
lore.text: The old king was buried with a crown that was never his to keep. Someone has put a hand on it. I feel it like a tooth going bad.

choices.text: Then come and help me pull it.

impressed.speaker: brunhild
impressed.text: Not failed. Cut. Somebody who knew the words unsaid them. You know your rites, friend. Good. I am tired of explaining.

not_quite.speaker: brunhild
not_quite.text: Failed? Hah. I laid those rites myself and they do not fail. They were cut. There is a difference, and it is a worse one.

choices.text: Will you help me find who cut them?

join.speaker: brunhild
join.text: I have been waiting three weeks for someone foolish enough to go up there with me. Let me fetch my mace.
